description: Cadernos de Drenagem is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Os Cadernos de Drenagem são estudos técnicos detalhados, desenvolvidos pela SIURB/PMSP com apoio técnico da FCTH, que analisa o sistema de drenagem urbana em uma área específica. Ele contém diagnósticos sobre a infraestrutura existente, identificação de áreas de risco de alagamento e propostas de intervenções para o controle de cheias. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Meio Físico, Hidrografia, macrodrenagem, planejamento, inlandWaters. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
